# Vendor documentation

Vendor PDFs are not redistributed in this repository. Use WEEROC's maintained
sources so readers get the current documents and their original licensing and
revision context:

- [RADIOROC 2 product page](https://www.weeroc.com/read_out_chips/radioroc-2/)
- [RADIOROC document library](https://www.weeroc.com/~documents/products/radioroc/?layout=list)
- [Evaluation Board RADIOROC 2 v3 user guide](https://www.weeroc.com/~documents/products/radioroc/radioroc2-evaluation-board-v3-0125/evaluation-board-radioroc2-v3-user-guide/?layout=file)

The product page and document library include the evaluation-board schematic,
EdgeBoard schematic, datasheets, user guide, components and vendor software.
Document names and revisions can change; record the revision used in any lab
log or technical comparison.
